lots.guide_summary: All surviving evidence is SOLD except one ASKING-style guide (Valerian). Whole-lot comparables: Gowans 6-Pop box lots sold $17 to $40 hammer (5 lots, 2025-12 to 2026-07), 7-Pop lots to $55. Individual figures on US eBay (via PriceCharting, rate US$1 = A$1.50 assumed, no live rate available): Edna Jack-Jack about A$45, Lukaku A$11 to A$105 by condition (this box is scuffed), the other four A$1.50 to A$17 each.
lots.working: Rate US$1 = A$1.50 (assumed, goldprice FX endpoint refused). KEEP: lowest in-window (since 2024-10-07) boxed SOLD per figure: Edna US$30, Lukaku US$7.26, Trini US$0.99, Spy Gru US$0.99, Aguilar US$0.99, Valerian no sale (0) = US$40.23 = A$60.35; 60.35 / 1.198 = 50.37, down to $50. Cross-check: Gowans 6-Pop lots $17-40 hammer, so you should rarely need $50. FLIP: realistic resale selling individually in Australia about A$80 gross (Edna A$40, Lukaku scuffed A$15, four others about A$6 each), less eBay fees about 13% (A$10.40) and outbound packing about A$2 each (A$12) = A$57.60; 57.60 / 2.396 = 24.04, down to $20.
lots.confidence_reason: All six labels and numbers read in the photo and many SOLD pages opened, but US eBay prices need an assumed exchange rate, Lukaku box condition is poor, and Gowans whole-lot comps are unspecified contents.
lots.dropped_entries: Researcher's Aguilar US$6.19 (2025-11-27) dropped as a loose out-of-box sale, replaced with boxed US$7.00 (2026-07-14). Lot 413742 price corrected from $45 to $55. Edna US$18 (2024-07-29) kept out of maximum bids as older than 24 months. Valerian and Lukaku entries added, both found on PriceCharting contrary to the researcher.
lots.key_photo_findings: Single photo, six boxes in a carton, all labels legible. Edna Jack-Jack has the red '2018 Summer Convention Limited Edition' sticker. Trini has the 25th anniversary sticker. Aguilar has the Loot Crate exclusive sticker. Spy Gru is the standard black version, not a chase. Lukaku box: the printed portrait panel on the front left is badly rubbed or abraded and the window shows heavy glare. Other boxes look sound from the front; backs and tops not shown.
lots.condition: Boxed, figures look complete through windows; Lukaku box front printing rubbed; other box edges look fair to good from the front only.
lots.question_for_gowans: Can you confirm all six figures are inside their boxes, and whether any box (especially the Lukaku) has window splits, crushed corners or water damage on the back or top?

The three photo-checked look-alikes (plain wide pale jade bangles) sold $20, $50 and $55 in the last 12 months; the wider plain jade bangle field runs $5 to $55. lots.working: KEEP: lowest close look-alike SOLD = $20 (lot 393452); 20 / 1.198 = 16.69, down to $15. FLIP: likely resale about A$50 (median of the close look-alikes), less eBay fees about 13% (A$6.50) and postage about A$10 = A$33.50; 33.50 / 2.396 = 13.98, down to $10. Material untested, so these are caps for an ordinary jade-type bangle, not for certified jadeite.
lots.confidence_reason: No mark or certificate to read; material is unverified and comparables are other bangles of unknown material, matched only by photo.
lots.dropped_entries: Dropped lot 368484 ($130, 2025-10-19): its photo shows a gold-mounted hinged bangle with jade panels, not a plain stone bangle. Dropped lot 414495 'STONE BANGLE' ($17, 2026-06-08): photo shows a thin brown or tan jasper-type stone, a different material despite the same title. Dropped 371948 (cracked, sold with a figurine) and 429074 (carved dragon) as not comparable. Kept 376777, 383787/383894, 368573, 391859, 387053, 421176, 424123 and 427511 as category guide only. All prices and dates matched the API.
lots.key_photo_findings: One photo. Wide D-section plain bangle, pale lilac-grey to white with cloudy mottling and some granular texture, good polish. Enlarged lower edge shows a few small surface nicks or pits and a tiny brown spot; no obvious crack visible but the inner face and far side are only partly seen. No mark, certificate or tag text visible.
lots.condition: Polished, apparently uncracked from one view; minor surface nicks on the lower outer edge.
lots.question_for_gowans: Any certificate or test for the stone, its weight and inner diameter, and are there any cracks or chips when held to the light?
